description: Compare public song/story relationship metadata without authentication, or—with an authenticated current music_retrieval grant—retrieve related indexed evidence using query. Public mode returns only the public relationship context; authorized mode still returns no manuscript text and does not establish personal listening. Use get_song_dossier for song identity alone and find_audio_motif for audio-segment evidence. Spoiler-filtered relationships and source records remain bounded by the grant.

idempotency_key.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

query.description: Optional query, up to 500 characters. In anonymous public mode it is not used and only public relationship context is returned; with an authenticated matching grant, a nonempty query retrieves indexed relationship evidence.

receipt_id.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

name: compare_song_and_novel
title: compare song and novel
